segments.text: If you've ever spent an afternoon retyping a provider's CV into yet another form — this is for you. Lanyard connects to CAQH and pulls the whole profile: licenses, education, work history, malpractice coverage — even the documents. Everything lands in one place, organized and ready to use. And it doesn't go stale — Lanyard re-syncs every night, so when something changes in CAQH, it changes here too.
